visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-angle drone shot of a majestic grey stone castle with ivy-covered walls. A Canadian flag waves atop a turret. On the lush green lawn below, white chairs are arranged for an outdoor ceremony facing a floral arch. (2) A close-up shot transitions to a white fabric banner featuring elegant black calligraphy that reads 'BLAIRE And ELI', with the location 'Hatley Castle' and date 'May 25, 2025' printed below. (3) A bald groom in a classic black tuxedo and white rose boutonniere walks confidently down stone stairs toward the ceremony area, smiling as he passes seated guests. (4) The groom approaches an older woman in a shimmering silver-blue dress; they share a warm, emotional embrace while guests look on. (5) The bride, wearing a stunning off-the-shoulder white gown and a long veil, descends the grand stone staircase, escorted by an older man in a suit. (6) The scene shifts to the altar where the couple stands together. The camera captures close-ups of their joyful faces and the guests clapping enthusiastically in the background. (7) A cinematic montage features the wedding rings, invitations with 'BE' monograms, and a bottle of golden-hued perfume on a white surface. (8) During the vows, the groom carefully slides a ring onto the bride's finger; she smiles brightly, holding a microphone. Guests are seen wiping tears and filming with smartphones. (9) The couple appears on a balcony of the castle, raising wine glasses in a toast. A large white banner reading 'Welcome the wedding of BLAIRE And ELI' hangs over the stone railing. (10) The couple walks down the aisle through a shower of white streamers. They pause for a dramatic dip-kiss as family and friends cheer and wave their hands in celebration.

(2) [Subtitle]: With this ring, I marry you. 我以這枚戒指，與你締結婚約。 (3) [Subtitle]: For the very first time as a married couple — 今日，首次以夫妻之名， (4) [Subtitle]: Eli and Blaire, congratulations! 恭喜你們！ (5) [Slogan]: Welcome the wedding of BLAIRE And ELI.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 bride, 1 groom, 1 officiant, and approximately 22 guests and family members.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The groom is a bald man wearing a black tuxedo with a white rose. The bride has dark hair styled in an updo, wearing a white strapless wedding gown with a veil.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary background is Hatley Castle, a grand stone manor with historic architecture, surrounded by manicured green lawns, trimmed hedges, flower gardens, and a dense forest perimeter.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, finger-picked acoustic guitar melody accompanied by a warm piano chord progression. A smooth, male indie-pop vocal track starts, singing sentimental lyrics about searching for something. (2) As the visual transitions to the ceremony, high-frequency rhythmic hand-clapping emerges from the crowd, blending with the ongoing music. (3) The music ducks slightly in volume to make room for clear, dry dialogue. A male voice (the groom) speaks his vows with a steady, emotional tone, followed by a female voice (the bride) repeating the phrases into a microphone. (4) After the vows, the music swells with an added violin and cello layer. The crowd erupts into high-arousal cheering, laughter, and vocalizations. (5) A resonant male announcer's voice (the officiant) is heard projecting over the music, declaring the couple married. The audio ends with a crescendo of cheering and the fading musical outro.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Ceremony Highlights -> Vows -> Celebration
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a high-production wedding highlight reel designed to capture the romance and grandeur of a wedding ceremony at Hatley Castle. It combines cinematic drone footage, intimate close-ups, and recorded vows to create an emotional narrative for the couple and their social media audience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While brands of perfume and stationery appear, they are presented as personal wedding details rather than paid placements.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully uses audio-visual synchronization, particularly matching the emotional peaks of the BGM with the dip-kiss and celebratory streamers.
